projects.name: DropNet
projects.description: Cross-platform offline file transfer application built using Flutter.
projects.shortDescription: Fast and seamless peer-to-peer file sharing without relying on cloud storage.
projects.originStory: DropNet was created because many file transfer solutions either depended on internet connectivity or felt unnecessarily complicated.
projects.technicalOverview: Uses temporary local server architecture, socket communication, peer discovery and direct device-to-device networking concepts.
projects.favoritePart: Designing a seamless file-sharing experience with minimal friction.
lessonsLearned: Networking bugs are usually harder than UI bugs.
Reliable communication is more difficult than it initially appears.
Simple UX often requires complex engineering.
projects.importance: Most important and most representative project.
projects.recruiterPitch: Demonstrates networking, architecture, UI engineering, state management and real-world problem solving.

projects.name: UltraVision
projects.status: In development. Not public yet; it will be made public soon.
projects.description: A Flutter app that runs AI models on the device itself, with a Material 3 Expressive interface. Model weights are not bundled: you download them from the in-app Model Marketplace or import your own files.
projects.shortDescription: On-device AI gallery for Android, iOS, macOS, Windows and Linux. In development, public soon.
features: Playground with nine Marvel-inspired personas (Human Torch, J.A.R.V.I.S., DUM-E, U, F.R.I.D.A.Y., E.D.I.T.H., Vision, Ultron, Jocasta), each with its own tone, colour, shape and built-in offline voice
Plain model chat with thinking mode, stats, dictation and read-aloud
Agent Skills: Wikipedia, map cards, visual summaries, calculator, unit converter, photo search, image generation; extra skill packs load from a URL
Instant Media Search: photo search that updates as you type, using CLIP on ONNX Runtime
Video Moment Finder: embeds video frames with CLIP and ranks moments on a heat timeline
Ask Image: ask a vision model about up to 10 images
Audio Scribe: transcribe, summarise, translate or list action items from a recording
Prompt Lab with temperature, top-K and token controls plus TTFT and decode-speed stats
Tiny Garden: a 3x3 garden you tend with natural-language commands through function calls
Device Actions such as flashlight, alarms, calendar events and app launch, with confirmation for risky ones
Enhance & Upscale: on-device photo upscaling (2x/4x), face fix, denoise and repair with a before/after view
Model Marketplace with six categories, RAM-fit hints, resumable SHA-256 verified downloads
projects.originStory: I wanted the AI features people usually rent from a server to run on the phone in your pocket, with the personality of the assistants I grew up watching.
projects.favoritePart: Every persona has its own voice that works offline. DUM-E and U even beep and whirr.
projects.importance: My most ambitious project so far. It is still in development and will be made public soon.
projects.recruiterPitch: Shows on-device ML integration (llama.cpp, CLIP, Whisper, diffusion), multi-platform Flutter architecture and product design at scale.

projects.name: FetchNet
projects.description: A simple cross-platform downloader for video, audio and images, built in Flutter as a graphical interface for the open-source tools yt-dlp and gallery-dl. Paste a link, pick a quality, done.
projects.shortDescription: Flutter front end for yt-dlp and gallery-dl on Android and Windows.
platforms: macOS and Linux build from source (untested on hardware)
features: Paste links from YouTube and the thousands of sites yt-dlp supports; links shared from other Android apps open straight in it
Video from 144p to 4K merged to MP4, or audio as MP3 (320/192/128 kbps), M4A or the original stream
Posts and galleries from Instagram, X, Reddit, Pinterest and more through gallery-dl, sorted into Images, Audio and Video folders
On Android, yt-dlp, Python, FFmpeg and QuickJS are bundled in the app
projects.disclaimer: FetchNet only provides an interface to yt-dlp and gallery-dl. It does not host or distribute media; people should only download content they have the right to.
projects.recruiterPitch: Shows packaging native tooling (Python, FFmpeg) inside a Flutter app and shipping real releases.

projects.name: DropNet-CLI
projects.description: A pure-Python command-line companion to DropNet that sends any file to another device on the same network. No internet, no cloud, no accounts.
projects.shortDescription: Encrypted, verified LAN file transfers from the terminal.
features: Zero-config discovery of receivers on the LAN through a UDP beacon, or send straight to a known IP
Optional end-to-end encryption with a 6-character session code using Fernet (AES-128-CBC + HMAC)
SHA-256 and CRC32 checks on every transfer
Animated progress bars and panels built with rich
Setup checker that detects and fixes the Python installation
projects.recruiterPitch: Shows low-level networking, encryption and integrity checks without a framework.

notes.title: Projects I no longer show
notes.content: PixelPioneers AI is no longer part of my portfolio. If someone asks about it, say it was an older experiment with image generation and that my current focus is DropNet, FetchNet, DropNet-CLI and UltraVision. It lacked the reliability and scalibity that I hoped to have build with it. But Project UltraVision is not just going replace PixelPioneers AI but also add every feature and capability that I once intended PixelPioneers to achieve.

notes.title: UltraVision status
notes.content:
UltraVision is in development and not public yet. I plan to make it public soon. There is no download or repository link to share at the moment, so if someone asks for one, tell them it is coming and point them to the contact channels to hear when it ships.

It is version 0.0.5 right now. Recent work added built-in offline voices for every persona and an Enhance & Upscale tool for photos.

If someone asks which persona to try first: J.A.R.V.I.S. for calm help, Ultron for drama, DUM-E if you enjoy being beeped at.
